title: Holographic Invariant Storage: Design-Time Safety Contracts via Vector Symbolic Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2603.13558v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce Holographic Invariant Storage (HIS), a protocol that assembles known properties of bipolar Vector Symbolic Architectures into a design-time safety contract for LLM context-drift mitigation. The contract provides three closed-form guarantees evaluable before deployment: single-signal recovery fidelity converging to $1/\sqrt{2} \approx 0.707$ (regardless of noise depth or content), continuous-noise robustness $2\Phi(1/\sigma) - 1$, and multi-signal capacity degradation $\approx\sqrt{1/(K+1)}$. These bounds, validated by Monte Carlo simulation ($n = 1{,}000$), enable a systems engineer to budget recovery fidelity and codebook capacity at design time -- a property no timer or embedding-distance metric provides. A pilot behavioral experiment (four LLMs, 2B--7B, 720 trials) confirms that safety re-injection improves adherence at the 2B scale; full results are in an appendix.

translated_title: 全息不变存储：通过向量符号架构实现设计时安全契约
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.13558v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：我们引入了全息不变存储（HIS），一种协议，它将双极向量符号架构的已知属性组装成一种设计时安全契约，用于缓解LLM上下文漂移。该契约提供了三种在部署前可评估的闭式保证：单信号恢复保真度收敛至$1/\sqrt{2} \approx 0.707$（无论噪声深度或内容如何），连续噪声鲁棒性$2\Phi(1/\sigma) - 1$，以及多信号容量退化$\approx\sqrt{1/(K+1)}$。这些边界，通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证（$n = 1{,}000$），使系统工程能够在设计时预算恢复保真度和码本容量——这是计时器或嵌入距离度量无法提供的属性。一项初步行为实验（四个LLM，2B--7B，720次试验）确认安全再注入在2B规模下提高了遵从性；完整结果见附录。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于向量符号架构的全息不变存储协议，通过提供设计时闭式安全契约（恢复保真度、噪声鲁棒性和容量退化）来缓解LLM上下文漂移，无需部署即可评估性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a Holographic Invariant Storage protocol based on vector symbolic architectures, offering design-time closed-form safety contracts (recovery fidelity, noise robustness, and capacity degradation) to mitigate LLM context drift, evaluable before deployment.
